caption: Cut mode armed (toolbar scissors or X): dashed guide lines extend from the pins of visible components along their pin axis; where a guide crosses a perpendicular waveguide with enough straight run, a circular candidate marker appears.
Hovering a candidate fills and enlarges the marker (screen-constant size), so the exact insertion point is unambiguous before clicking.

Clicking inserts the PDK crossing (ebeam_crossing4) centered on the intersection; the waveguide splits into two connections docked onto the crossing's through ports. The crossing is user intent — the adaptive pass never dissolves it.
The insertion is one undoable command: Ctrl+Z removes the crossing and restores the original connection with all fine-tuning settings preserved.
